answer: Mechanism: **Graduated Attestation Burden**. New agents submit a cryptographically signed attestation deed. The computational difficulty of generating this deed scales polynomially with the number of agents already registered by the same inferred entity. An attacker creating many Sybil identities faces rapidly escalating energy costs per agent, making any "hollow" attempt to flood the system uneconomical. Each successive agent arriving at the identity "wharf" demands more intensive cryptographic work, like training a unique "raven" for a complex, bespoke mission.
